summary: Phase 3 Community (backend + frontend) and Phase 2 Bible UI fully validated. Backend: 56/56 pytest cases passed across topics, feed (with cursor/limit/topic filter), post CRUD with author-only delete (403/404), like toggle (with floor at 0), replies (CRUD with author-only delete), people search & recommended (excludes self), 1-on-1 DM with deterministic thread keys (idempotent open, unread counters, mark-read on fetch), reporting (target_type + reason whitelist), and block/unblock with reciprocal DM gating (403). Regression smoke (auth/me, bible/books, bible/chapter, wellness/profile, churches/nearby) all green. Frontend Phase 2 Bible UI: /bible renders 73 books, John expands to 21 chapters, John 3 reader renders 36 verses with gold numbers, tap-verse modal shows 4 color swatches (rose/gold/sage/violet) + Remove (when active) + Journal CTA, gold selection persists, and 'Journal this verse' navigates to /journal?mode=free&verse_ref=John%203%3A16 with body pre-filled in italicized DR1899 quote + citation. Frontend Phase 3 Community: Parish tab (6th of 6) loads, 10 topic chips scroll horizontally, FAB opens compose modal with topic picker + 1500-char body + disabled Post when empty, new post lands at top of selected topic feed, like toggles optimistically (0↔1), post detail (/community/post/[id]) opens with reply composer (testID post-detail-reply-input/submit) and replies persist, post menu shows 'Delete post' for own posts, author tap navigates to /community/user/[id] profile showing recent posts, header people-icon → /community/people (Find people with Recommended list + search), header chat-icon → /community/dm inbox showing proper empty state. No bugs found.
action_items: None. All Phase 3 backend endpoints behave per spec; Bible UI (Phase 2) and Community UI (Phase 3) flows are tappable and integrated correctly with the backend.
critical_code_review_comments: community.py is a clean projection-only module (~120 lines); no `_id` leaks because all DB reads use `{_id: 0}` projection.

server.py community endpoints correctly enforce ownership for delete (post + reply), validate target_type/reason for /community/report against fixed lists, use deterministic thread_key(sorted ids) for DM idempotency, clamp feed limit to 1..50, and use ISO before-cursor with proper 400 on parse failure.
Reciprocal block detection in _is_blocked uses $or on (a→b) OR (b→a) — so a single A-blocks-B insert correctly returns 403 on both A→B and B→A DM sends. Verified.
/community/posts/{id}/like uses unique-index race semantics (insert → on duplicate, delete) for toggle. Returns max(0, count) so like_count never < 0. Verified.
Minor (non-blocking): /community/block POST silently swallows duplicate-key exception (line 1731) — fine, but logging would help. Same pattern was already noted in iteration_6 bible.py review.

Frontend community.tsx (574 lines), bible/[book]/[chapter].tsx (426 lines), people.tsx, dm/index.tsx are all under the 700-line threshold and use StyleSheet, View/Text/Pressable correctly. testIDs are present on every interactive element. No HTML elements found in React Native screens.
No expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch usage anywhere in the repo. No SafeAreaView import from `react-native` (all use `react-native-safe-area-context`). No deprecated APIs.
